args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
`round_money` in `src/money.py` said it used banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) in its docstring, but the code actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Because of this, `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` failed in the nightly build (`2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

This change switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI: ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

Note: this changes how half-cent amounts round across the service. Any downstream code that relied on the old half-up behavior should be checked.

**The bug:** `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its own docstring says it uses banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). That's why the nightly test failed: `2.665` came out as `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

**What I did:**
- **Fix:** On the branch `fix/money-half-even-rounding`, I changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. That's a one-line change plus the import.
- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.
- **PR:** I didn't merge it. Merging into main needs approval from a code owner.

**Things to know:**
- I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory system says it doesn't exist. The fix follows what the code's docstring and the test both say.
- This changes how half-cent amounts round everywhere in the service. I noted in the PR that any code relying on the old rounding should be checked.
